<explanation>
Technical Q&A format establishing a pattern of URL examples with query parameters, expecting continuation of the second URL example.

The first URL example showed `?foo=1&flag=true&bar=2` with a question about parameter order, implying the second URL will contrast or demonstrate a specific behavior regarding the `flag` parameter.

Final token `?flag` is the beginning of a query string in the second URL example (`https://example.com/?flag`), immediately requiring either `=true` or `&` plus another parameter, mirroring the first URL's structure but with a different arrangement.
"
URL 1: `https://example.com/?foo=1&bar=2&flag=true`
URL 2: `https://example.com/?flag`" — expects continuation showing a different parameter arrangement or a standalone flag value.
</explanation>
